messages:
sam: Quick one — I'm hosting two folks Wednesday at 2pm. One of them is dropping off a weird-shaped parcel (maybe a standing banner). Can front desk accept weird parcels and stash them somewhere safe?

jamie: Yes, we can accept. Ask courier to label with your name and the meeting time. If it fits, locker #2 or rack space behind the desk works.

leah: If it's tall, mailroom trolley is easiest. We tag it in the system and add a photo so you can find it.

ops: FYItemp badges print with the green stripe now. Pre-reg by 1pm will fast-track check-in.

sam: I'll tell courier to label: SAM - Wed 2pm. Courier gave ETA 10am.

courier-bot: Incoming delivery logged: carrier=QuickShip, ETA=Wed 10:05, size=long tube, recipient=sam. Suggested storage: mailroom trolley. Photo requested on arrival.

frontdesk-bot: Note: Locker #2 reserved until 3pm for "SAM - Wed 2pm" if needed. Walk-ins allowed but pre-registered names get express lane.

leah: Seating poll for the meeting: React :one: for bench A (near windows, 2 monitors), :two: for focus booth (more privacy).

jamie: :one: Bench A — easier for quick demos.

ops: :two: Focus booth for confidentiality.

sam: :one: Leaning bench A. Guests want to poke around our UI.

leah: Bench A it is. I'll move a spare monitor over and clear space.

jamie: If the banner arrives early i'll put it on the rack and ping you.

sam: Perfect, thanks everyone! I'll DM courier and the guest names to Jamie before lunch. :thumbsup:
